question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Overlook
solution:
The correct answer is: Notice

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Overlook means to fail to see or notice something.

 
 
• Example -* I will **overlook **your behavior this time but don’t let it happen again.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Notice means to see and become conscious of something.
 
 
• Example -* The protests are finally making the government take **notice**.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Overlook' and 'Notice' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Ignore means paying no attention to somebody/something.
 
• Neglect means giving too little or no attention or care to somebody/something.
 
• Visualize means to imagine or have a picture in your mind of somebody/something.
